weather_report:
As twilight deepens over Boston, the air is crisp, hinting at the cooling embrace of autumn, with temperatures dipping to a refreshing 42 degrees. A gentle southwest breeze rustles through the streets, whispering of a night that will remain partly cloudy—a perfect backdrop for the shimmering city lights scattered across the horizon. With the beauty of the evening sky peeking through, it’s a moment to pause and appreciate the mosaic of light against the dark.

Looking ahead to tomorrow, the day promises to unfold gracefully, with the sun emerging to bathe the city in a soft, golden light. Expected highs near 57 degrees will invite wanderers and locals alike to don layers that balance warmth with comfort. A light jacket and a scarf would serve well against the west wind, which may rise to playful gusts, adding an exhilarating touch to any afternoon stroll. Amid this agreeable weather, afternoons can best be spent exploring the local cafés, indulging in a warm beverage while observing the world drift by from a cozy window seat, or perhaps wandering through the charming streets, where the unmistakable sights of autumn foliage provide a visual feast.

As night settles once again, the allure of gathering with friends around an outdoor fire pit or taking a leisurely train ride along the coastline will beckon—offering not just warmth but shared moments wrapped in laughter and conversation amidst the serene backdrop of Boston’s night sky.
